caption: The drawing depicts a single barrel-shaped stoneware container placed upright against a plain, light background. The body of the barrel is a light grayish-brown color with subtle speckling, and it features decorative bands painted in cobalt blue near the top, bottom, and around the middle. The barrel has a circular wooden lid shown on top, and a rectangular spigot hole at the bottom front center. Prominently displayed on the front of the barrel is a blue illustration of a fish with pronounced fins and scales oriented horizontally. Above the fish, there is a cobalt blue arch with the word “FISH” inside it, framing an image of a hop cone with leaves. Below this design is the text “M. TYLER & CO ALBANY” written in capital blue letters. The shading and brushstrokes give the barrel a three-dimensional appearance, and the blue accents stand out sharply against the neutral body of the barrel. The background is off-white, and there are a few small spots of discoloration visible, mostly near the top of the paper.
title: Holland Gin Keg
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
